summary: This is a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) filed by Hydro One Ltd. The filing contains a press release dated June 9, 2026, announcing that Megan Telford became President and CEO and was elected to the Board of Directors, succeeding David Lebeter who retired. No price, premium, or deal terms are involved; it is a routine leadership transition. The board recommended the election as part of the annual meeting. This is a Management Change event due to the departure/retirement of the prior CEO and appointment of a new one.
